hints.content: The slope field gives strong evidence that $y=4$ is a horizontal asymptote to any particular solution whose initial condition has $0\le y<\infty$.
With the initial condition $(0,1)$, the solution curve is strictly increasing with an upper bound of $4$.  Hence, the range of the solution is $[1,4)$.
